753:t_010:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Let's do it! We're betting everything we have on these five minutes!」

753:t_010:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「All units, begin the attack! Let's go!」

753:t_010:4.en:
$n
「We'll stop you for sure, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'll protect the lives of this universe!!」

753:t_010:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Come at me with everything you have. And feel it with your own bodies: the magnitude of what you are challenging... the resolve of one who will become a god.」

753:t_010:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「For the blessing of the new world.」

753:t_011:0.en:
$$チコ$$
「What the heck is with this guy's strength!」

753:t_011:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Even so, we're dealing damage! All that's left is to keep piling it up!」

753:t_011:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「...If a hundred 1s gather, they make 100... If a hundred 100s gather, they make 10,000...」

753:t_011:3.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's how I've been paying off my debts!」

753:t_011:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But that logic doesn't work here. A god is immortal.」

753:t_012:0.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Impossible! How can this be...!」

753:t_012:1.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「All the damage we've dealt so far is being restored...!」

753:t_012:2.en:
$$キリコ$$
「So everything up to now was for nothing.」

753:t_012:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「It pains me... If you had meekly accepted your fate, I would never have had to give you despair like this.」

753:t_012:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But now you understand, don't you? Even if you stop the Supreme God's movements, it becomes meaningless in an instant.」

753:t_012:8.en:
$$トライア$$
「...It's no use... Our dimensional barrier can't possibly contain that immense a dimensional force...」

753:t_012:9.en:
$$スザク$$
「Then even if we defeat him...!」

753:t_012:10.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Is there no way to stop the super-regeneration...」

753:t_012:13.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You fall... into a darkness deeper and blacker than despair... soundlessly, known to no one...」

753:t_012:14.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I will save you from that. By plucking your lives.」

753:t_013:1.en:
$$ボス$$
「You still had that much firepower left!?」

753:t_013:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I didn't have it. I have just created it, now.」

753:t_013:4.en:
$$ロゼ$$
「Creating something from nothing... That is... the power of a god...」

753:t_013:6.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Even this will not be enough to break the fighting spirit of those who have fought this far...」

753:t_013:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「So I will use this, too.」

753:t_075:0.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「A giant of white crystal!」

753:t_075:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「They are the $$ネオ・リアクター$$s.」

753:t_075:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「After I gathered the $$スフィア$$s, I prepared a false life for each of them in order to draw out their power.」

753:t_075:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「For now, I have given them Fake $$スフィア$$s... substitutes, and they serve as my hands and feet.」

753:t_075:7.en:
$$シン$$
「Each one corresponds to one of the $$スフィア$$s!?」

753:t_075:9.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$セツコ$$, $$ランド$$, $$クロウ$$... and $n. Now that the Supreme God is reborn and they are here, I will free you from your long suffering.」

753:t_075:10.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Sleep in my arms, old Reactors.」

753:t_075:11.en:
$$メール$$
「Don't talk about Darling like he's useless! You're the one who's a pest to the universe!」

753:t_075:12.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「I understand that you don't want to admit it. But...」

753:t_075:13.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't talk like you know anything! What do you mean, understand!」

753:t_075:14.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You don't understand a damn thing, not the slightest bit, about other people.」

753:t_075:15.en:
$$セツコ$$
「If you understood anyone's heart, you couldn't possibly accept the collapse of the universe!」

753:t_075:16.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That is not so. At least I understand exactly how you feel right now.」

753:t_075:17.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Your hearts are finally ruled by despair, and the fighting spirit that carried you this far is about to break.」

753:t_075:20.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「So long as you don't vanish beyond the causal horizon, you too will someday, in the cycle of reincarnation, gain new lives in a new universe.」

753:t_075:21.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Let us rejoice together that we can cast away all of the past. Today is not an end, but a beginning.」

753:t_075:23.en:
$n
「...I knew it. You really don't understand anything...」

753:t_075:25.en:
$n
「As long as we're alive, we can fight! If you want to break our fighting spirit, kill us!」

753:t_075:26.en:
$n
「The power of life that you fear...! If you can wipe it out, go ahead and try!」

753:t_075:27.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「...How sad... I may not have felt an emotion like this in 120 million years.」

753:t_075:28.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But I will overcome that pain. Granting your wish will be my final mercy...」

753:t_073:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, everyone. I'm ashamed to say it, but what remains of the $$サイデリアル$$... has come to lend you a hand.」

753:t_073:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Leave the enemies around us to us!」

753:t_073:3.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Please bring down the center of the distortion!」

753:t_073:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$サルディアス$$! $$ダバラーン$$ and $$尸刻$$ too!」

753:t_073:5.en:
$$カティ$$
「This is Brigadier General $$カティ・マネキン$$ of the $$新地球連邦軍$$.」

753:t_073:7.en:
$$カティ$$
「We'll give everything we have to back up $c! So don't give up hope!」

753:t_073:8.en:
$$イザーク$$
「Leave the defense of Earth to us!」

753:t_073:9.en:
$$ディアッカ$$
「So we're counting on you at the front!」

753:t_073:10.en:
$$アスラン$$
「$$イザーク$$! $$ディアッカ$$ too!」

753:t_073:11.en:
$$イズモ$$
「The $$アルテア$$ army will join the fight too! Fight until the very last moment!」

753:t_073:13.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Old man $$イズモ$$ came here too!?」

753:t_073:14.en:
$$アマタ$$
「No, $$カグラ$$. That's our dad.」

753:t_073:16.en:
$$ヘンケン$$
「Nobody on our side has given up either!」
